title: Initial cleaning-machine step
statement: Let $M$ be a machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $q_1$ and $q$ be states and $V$ an input word. One step of the cleaning machine constructed from $M$ with initial state $q_1$, starting from its initial configuration with state $\mathrm{init}(q)$ on $V$, yields the simulation configuration for $M$, started in state $q$ on $V$, at time zero.
